_about: The 介紹頁's screenshots (SP-622; backend/scripts/manual_shots.py --set intro --full: the full demo year, its 50K course): each taken in zh-TW and en, light and dark, on the synthetic demo athlete, saved as backend/static/intro/<name>.<locale>[.dark].webp. Keys as backend/tests/e2e/shots.py's shot list; "page" / "path" gets ?lang=<locale> added. R2 (readable on the page): each is one small part of a screen, taken at phone width and at twice the pixels, so the page shows it near the app's own text size instead of a whole desktop screen shrunk to half. SP-637: the hero's calculator result and the legs table are live parts of the page now (the small calculator, the elevation profile), no longer pictures. SP-637 R1: the 課表 week is live too now (the hero calendar), no longer a picture.
